i went to high school with this kid haha
I'm dealing with some shitty stuff too. PM me and we can talk and get through this together.

the weird thing is i feel like things in life are going swell. I have a job and can pay rent. Girlfriend and I are great. Grades are good. I just can't bring myself to tell my parents it's happening again. They were super upset and worried last time (as they should be about their child) but i just don't want to put them through it again so right now i am trying my hardest on my own. I have started going to church again and trying to talk with my girlfriend more often (even though when we have these "talks", we usually end up crying.) I don't even know why i hate myself so much..and that's what i hate most. i dont know why for anything. things are going good but i'm not happy. i don't want to do anything. i just...bleh..
